items.title: Explore 2027 Hiking Bear
items.alt: A smiling brown bear with a coral backpack holds a wooden Explore 2027 sign beside a pine sprig.
items.description: A rolled sleeping mat rests atop the backpack, while the bear’s paws grip the plank above its large coral year numerals.

items.title: New Stories 2027 Dragon and Book
items.alt: A turquoise dragon curls around a navy book titled New Stories 2027, spreading gold-lined wings.
items.description: The dragon’s claws rest along the top of the ornate cover, and its curled tail circles the lower corner beside a ribbon bookmark.

items.title: Ivory and Rose Gold Stacked 2027
items.alt: Ivory serif numerals arranged as 20 above 27, with thick rose-gold sidewalls and recessed counters.
items.description: The projecting serifs and smooth pale faces give the stacked year a sculptural, architectural form.

items.title: Connect in 2027 Teamwork Ring
items.alt: Five gold, teal and navy person-shaped figures link around gold 2027 numerals above a Connect in 2027 ribbon.
items.description: The abstract figures hold a circular gold line, giving the networking emblem an open center and a clear lower message.

items.title: Plan Create Grow 2027 Desk
items.alt: A wooden desk holds an open laptop displaying 2027, a potted plant and a notebook beneath Plan Create Grow lettering.
items.description: A cream upholstered chair faces the compact workspace, balancing the leafy plant on the left and gold pencil on the right.

items.title: Folded Gold Ribbon 2027
items.alt: 2027 numerals shaped from broad folded gold ribbons with burgundy inner surfaces.
items.description: Curled metal-like bands form airy digits, with the zero kept open and the seven ending in a clean diagonal.
